name: phonemail
description: Email where your phone number is your address.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/server
